description:

The team is sent to a high-tech research facility where the researchers have been turned into mindless monsters by a bizarre power source in the center's lab.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E04 — The Hustler Job
The crew takes on a phone scamming ring that uses deepfake technology to con their marks, run by an old school hustler who came up via the pool hall circuit; to infiltrate his organization, they have to best him on and off the felt.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E05 — The Grand Complication Job
When Sophie is abducted, rivals Parker and Astrid are forced into a desperate race against time to save her by securing the elusive Marie Antoinette watch; unaware of each other's involvement, they embark on a high stakes quest to save Sophie.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E07 — And the Con-Con
Connor is forced to reconnect with people from his pre-Library life, and must defeat an old adversary who has grown powerful in his absence.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E08 — And the Hangover From Hell
After a bachelorette party with Lysa's childhood best friend, the team wakes up in rough shape and hungover, with no idea how they ended up where they are.

title: Eyes of the Roshi
description: A fugitive grandmaster has to summon his inner warrior to defeat an assassin.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E11 — The Juror No. 6 Job
One of Parker's aliases is chosen for jury duty; the team tries to stop someone from buying a favorable verdict in the trial.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E10 — The 12 Step Job
The team tricks an alcoholic financier into rehab to try to recover the money he swindled from a charity.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E12 — The First David Job
The team targets the CEO who denied Nate's son medical treatment.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E13 — The Second David Job
Nate comes out of hiding and tries to get his team back together to directly challenge Sterling and Blackpoole.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E01 — The Beantown Bailout Job
Nate reassembles the team to pit the local Irish mob against a banker who is gaming a government bailout.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E02 — The Tap-Out Job
The crew tries to get a corrupt mixed martial arts promoter to invest in a fake cable television network.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E03 — The Order 23 Job
The team goes after a shady hedge-fund manager; the mark is in the custody of the U.S. Marshals and is being hunted by the Armenian mob.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E04 — The Fairy Godparents Job
A clinic is forced to close because its funds were lost in a Ponzi scheme; the team goes after a corrupt investment banker who has money hidden from the authorities.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E05 — The Three Days of the Hunter Job
A TV host claims a school-bus driver caused an accident that left two children dead; Sophie takes the lead as the team sets out to put the host in her place.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E06 — The Top Hat Job
The team tries to infiltrate a corporation responsible for putting tainted food on the market.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E07 — The Two Live Crew Job
The team must go up against a crew of thieves in order to retrieve a priceless artwork.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E08 — The Ice Man Job
Hardison acts as the inside man when the team goes after an unscrupulous diamond merchant.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E09 — The Lost Heir Job
The team tries to stop a corrupt lawyer from taking over his client's estate.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E10 — The Runway Job
The team infiltrates the fashion world to take down a sweatshop owner.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E11 — The Bottle Job
The team runs a high-tech version of a classic con in order to save a bar from a loan shark.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E12 — The Zanzibar Marketplace Job
The team has to work with Sterling to free Maggie from a Ukrainian jail.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E13 — The Future Job
A con man masquerades as a psychic medium in order to steal money from his clients.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E14 — The Three Strikes Job
The team runs into an unexpected complication while trying to take down a corrupt mayor.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E15 — The Maltese Falcon Job
Surrounded by FBI and with Sterling hot on their heels, the team decides to hide in plain sight, while continuing to take down the corrupt mayor and his gunrunning partner; Nate has a different endgame in mind for them all.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E01 — The Jailhouse Job
In order to save the life of an innocent inmate, Nate must bring down the corrupt warden of the prison where he is incarcerated and escape.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E02 — The Reunion Job
The team infiltrates the high school reunion of a software magnate who is involved with the Axis of Evil.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E03 — The Inside Job
When Parker is trapped in an unknown location while working a theft for her mentor, the team must race the clock to find and free her.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E04 — The Scheherazade Job
In order to rob a Boston vault, the team must time their heist to a nearby symphony concert.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E05 — The Double Blind Job
Nate and the team try to take down a corrupt CEO before he can release a drug that will kill thousands.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E06 — The Swipe Right Job
Sophie's return to dating goes awry when her newest flame is a billionaire, swindling men and women to fund his lavish lifestyle; to dismantle his million dollar scheme, the team must create the perfect romantic specimen and bait the catfish.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E07 — The Shakedown in Clone-Town Job
Sophie, Eliot and Parker get caught in a small-town speed trap run by a corrupt mayor; they decide to help the oppressed townspeople wrest power from his hungry clutches.

title: Almost Paradise
description:
S02 E05 — Deus Ex-Wife Machina
Alex's ex-wife shows up with her new fiancé asking Alex to sign their divorce papers; however, when the fiancé is mistaken for Alex and kidnapped by an old enemy, Alex finds himself racing to rescue the man.

title: Almost Paradise
description:
S02 E06 — Ghost Month
During the traditional Ghost Month in the Philippines, Alex seems to be visited by the spirit of a dead man, wrongly accused of a crime, who seeks justice from the afterlife.

title: The Ark
description:
S02 E01 — Failed Experiment
The crew must decide the best way forward with or without help from their nemesis, Evelyn Maddox.

title: The Ark
description:
S02 E02 — Kill or Be Killed
The arrival of new crew members presents questions of who can be trusted and what to do with them.

description:
S01 E09 — And the Feast of the Vampire
While on a visit to a small-town festival, Connor encounters the very first vampire, and finds himself fighting the clock to save himself from turning into one.

description:
S01 E10 — And Going Medieval
When Vikram attempts to return to 1847, via a homemade time machine, he inadvertently travels the entire team back to the days of King Arthur, where they learn the truth about a Knight of the Round Table, Camelot, and Elaine.
